items.exampleEn: She went back to the restaurant to retrieve her umbrella.
items.exampleZh: 她回到餐廳去拿回她的雨傘。

items.exampleEn: The new bridge is near completion.
The officer inspected our passports at the border.
items.exampleZh: 官員在邊境查驗了我們的護照。

items.exampleEn: The designer quickly sketched a few ideas on paper.
items.exampleZh: 設計師很快地在紙上畫了幾個構想的草圖。

items.exampleEn: The old pipe under the sink is leaking.
items.exampleZh: 水槽下面那根舊水管在漏水。

items.exampleEn: It took him a year to compile the city's first food guide.
items.exampleZh: 他花了一年編寫這座城市的第一本美食指南。

items.exampleEn: The strike disrupted train services across the country.
items.exampleZh: 罷工讓全國的火車服務大亂。

items.exampleEn: Please alert the manager if you see anything unusual.
items.exampleZh: 如果看到任何異常，請通知經理。

items.sentenceEn: The workers will inspect every machine before the factory opens.
items.sentenceZh: 工廠開工前，工人會檢查每一台機器。

items.audioEn: The loud building work next door disrupted our meeting, so we moved to another room.
items.audioZh: 隔壁施工太吵，打斷了我們的會議，所以我們換到另一間會議室。
items.questionZh: 他們為什麼換到另一間會議室？
options: The room was too small for everyone
The building work was too loud
All the lights in the room went out
A client wanted to meet in that room

items.sentenceEn: Water is leaking from the ceiling above my desk.
items.sentenceZh: 水正從我桌子上方的天花板漏下來。

items.sentenceEn: Our phones alert us when a big storm is coming.
items.sentenceZh: 大型暴風雨要來時，我們的手機會發出通知提醒我們。

items.stemEn: Could you ____ the sales numbers into one report by Friday?
items.stemZh: 你能在星期五前把銷售數字彙整成一份報告嗎？

items.stemEn: The new office will be ready after the ____ of the work in May.
items.stemZh: 新辦公室在五月工程完工後就能使用。

items.passageEn: Last Monday, water started to leak from a pipe above our meeting room. A colleague noticed the wet floor and alerted the building manager at once. The leak disrupted our work for the whole morning, because we had to move computers and papers out of the room. In the afternoon, a plumber came to inspect the pipes. He said a new pipe was needed, and he expected completion of the repair in two days. Meanwhile, our designer sketched a new plan for the room, and I compiled a list of everything that had been damaged. Luckily, we were able to retrieve all our files from the wet computers, so the damage was less costly than we feared.
items.passageZh: 上週一，我們會議室上方的一根水管開始漏水。一位同事發現地板濕了，馬上通知大樓管理員。漏水打亂了我們一整個早上的工作，因為我們得把電腦和文件搬出會議室。下午，一位水電工來檢查水管。他說需要換一根新水管，修理要兩天才能完成。在這期間，我們的設計師畫了會議室的新配置草圖，我則整理出一份所有受損物品的清單。幸好，濕掉的電腦裡的檔案我們全都找回來了，所以損失沒有我們擔心的那麼慘重。

questions.questionZh: 是誰發現漏水並通知管理員？
修理需要多久才能完成？

items.promptZh: 我忘了密碼，所以沒辦法取回我的檔案。
referenceEn: I forgot my password, so I can't retrieve my files.
Because I forgot the password, I couldn't retrieve my files.
rubricZh: retrieve 後面接要取回的東西（例如 retrieve my files）
「忘了密碼」可寫 forgot、have forgotten 等；「沒辦法」可寫 can't、couldn't 等

items.instructionZh: 用 alert 造一個句子，說說你遇到某種情況時通知了誰（或會通知誰）。
referenceEn: If I see smoke, I will alert the security guard right away.
I alerted my neighbor when I saw her window was open in the rain.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 alert，當動詞表示「通知、提醒」（例如 alert the guard）
句子要說清楚是什麼情況、通知了誰

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：「『忘了密碼』用過去式」過嚴：I've forgotten my password（現在完成式）同樣正確且常見，會被判錯。建議「『忘了密碼』可寫 forgot my password、have forgotten my password 等」。
